# Blueprint map: each exam task and the pages that teach it

The [CLF-C02 exam guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/cloud-practitioner-02/cloud-practitioner-02.html) splits the exam into four domains and 19 task statements. This page lists, for each task, every page of this guide that covers it, as each page's front matter declares. The task titles are our short names; each number links to the task in the exam guide.

[The exam at a glance](../00-start-here/03-the-exam-at-a-glance.md) gives an overview of every task, so it isn't repeated below.
